before: The 20 goals of `55/_wip/Osiris/ARC-0030/goals/` are in the game, `ARCANA_Spell_MirrorWithdraw` is out, and the
Play A.1–A.6 on a save made BEFORE the update (the tables must rebuild on load), the rest on any save.

sessions.name: Any level — full run
sessions.setup: a party with the subclass each test names, at the level it names; a fight you can start and finish.

tests.expected: Tier I awakens and its countdown shows, as before.
tests.fails: the Aspect never awakens or the countdown never shows.
tests.rule: RISKS A4, A5, A7 (tables rebuilt on load, type pins)
tests.steps: Load a save made before the update; start a fight; reach Tier I with any Arcana.
tests.title: A save made before the update loads with every Aspect working

tests.expected: a Double appears where she stood and Withdraw is offered.
tests.rule: RISKS A4 (the card table is cleared and refilled)
tests.steps: Deceiver; cast Distortion with a higher slot than its own level.
tests.title: An upcast Distortion still offers Withdraw

tests.expected: the Double has the Mirror spells of her level's slot tier.
tests.fails: the Double only has Shatter, Dismiss, Dash and Disengage.
tests.rule: RISKS A5 (the shapeshift rule table moved to an Init)
tests.steps: Deceiver level 5+ with Two Truths, on the old save; summon a Double with Mirror Image.
tests.title: A Double at level 5 or more keeps the Mirror spells of its tier

tests.expected: the burst lands and the Double is gone a moment later; nobody gains Doubt for its death.
tests.fails: the Double stays after its burst.
tests.rule: RISKS A3 (the Shatter timer is cancelled before its launch)
tests.steps: Order a Double to cast Shatter.
tests.title: Shatter still removes its Double

tests.fails: the enemy keeps its Doubt and is not Deluded.
tests.rule: RISKS A3 (the 900 ms timer is cancelled before its launch)
tests.steps: Deceiver at Tier III with an enemy at 1 Doubt near a Double; cast The Veil Lifts.
tests.title: The Veil Lifts still deludes the survivors with Doubt

tests.fails: she ends with A's look, or flickers between them.
tests.rule: RISKS A2 (the real-time timer's own cancel)
tests.steps: Out of combat, cast Faceless: Copy on character A, then at once on character B.
tests.title: Faceless: Copy cast twice ends in the second look

tests.expected: after the fight no creature keeps a Wheel position status, the crown or the Hand's crown.
tests.fails: a Rising / Reigning / Falling / Fallen status or the crown stays after the fight.
tests.steps: Kingmaker; bind an ally and an enemy; finish the fight.
tests.title: The Kingmaker's Wheel clears when its fight ends

tests.expected: the Wheel keeps its creatures and turns at her next turn start.
tests.fails: the positions vanish when the other fight ends.
tests.planb: if no second fight can be arranged, skip it; the osirislog of a normal fight end must show the clearing
tests.steps: Start a fight with the Kingmaker and bind two creatures; make a second, separate fight end elsewhere (a
tests.title: Another fight ending does not wipe the Wheel

tests.expected: in the first fight the grudge points at the ally it hit; in the second, the enemy takes the fallback
tests.fails: the second enemy holds a grudge on someone from the first fight.
tests.steps: Resonant; let an enemy hit an ally, then give that enemy Anger; finish the fight; in a new fight, give Anger
tests.title: An angered enemy holds its grudge only for the fight it is in

tests.expected: she has no ASPECT_AWAKENED status, no tier status and no countdown.
tests.fails: any Aspect status is still on her.
tests.steps: Awaken Tier I with any Arcana; let her die in the fight; win the fight; revive her.
tests.title: A character who dies with the Aspect awakened is clean after the fight

tests.expected: the enemy takes necrotic damage equal to the hit points it lost while it had the status.
tests.fails: no burst, or a burst of another amount.
tests.steps: Eternal; apply Hemorrhage to an enemy, hit it twice, let the status end.
tests.title: Hemorrhage still bursts

title: The Arcana — Osiris goals: standard and preventive fixes (any level)
